A patchwork intarsia cardigan with intricate cable detailing.

This cardigan is fully fashioned and hand-linked by highly skilled craftspeople at our purpose-built factory in Wigston, Leicestershire. 


It’s knitted with our trademark Supersoft lambswool and finished with sustainably sourced corozo nut buttons.

Size chart
Look after your garms
Our knitwear is made from 100% lambswool.
Lambswool is a natural fiber with anti-bacterial self cleaning properties.
It should be washed less frequently than the rest of your wardrobe.
We recommend airing your garment and spot cleaning where appropriate. When it comes time, wash by hand at 30ºC/85ºF and dry on a flat surface.
